title: IFX-V4-005: drain wait reports a timeout although the runtime is already idle
goal: Make RuntimeDrainCoordinator.WaitForIdleAsync report idle when the runtime became idle before the timeout was observed, and make the drain tests independent of thread-pool scheduling, so that CI solution evidence is not lost to a race.
acceptanceCriteria: WaitForIdleAsync returns true when idle completed before the timeout is observed and false only while work is still in flight.
The drain tests pass 200 consecutive times under parallel load; the solution build and all tests pass.
The 47 G04 runtime predicates still hold.
risks: A real drain timeout could be masked if the idle check were wrong; the existing timeout test keeps the false case covered.
decisions: Fix the product race rather than add retries in the evidence harness (I2-B ruling R4).
